node.label: HbH hemoglobin
node.definition: Hemoglobin H (HbH) contains four beta-globin chains. It is normally not present at all in blood, but may make up about 1-40 percent of all hemoglobin in HbH disease, a subform of alpha thalassemia.

evidence.snippet: Alpha-thalassemia/impaired intellectual development syndrome: HbH hemoglobin (frequency 1/1) [PCS]
